  children={"Turn backup encryption on or off"}

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/api/admin/backups/encryption"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Signed-in admin only (an API token gets `403`). Turning it on needs a
key (`POST /api/admin/backups/encryption/key`) and `kitSaved: true` —
the admin confirms the emergency kit is stored somewhere other than
this server — and makes a pending key the current one (also how a
key rotation is confirmed). While on, backups are written as age-encrypted
`famlin-backup-<timestamp>.zip.age` and no database dump is written.
Turning it off keeps the keys and leaves existing backups encrypted.
